title: Law to waive sidewalk cafe fees in some districts
summary: This bill would create a 2-year pilot program waiving license fees for sidewalk and roadway cafes in the 10 council districts with the fewest active cafe licenses. The Department of Transportation would run the program starting 90 days after the law takes effect. Within 90 days of the program's end, the transportation commissioner must report on its costs and effectiveness and recommend whether to make it permanent.
